purpose: Persistent structured memory system enabling agents to recall prior decisions, entity facts, project state, and operational context. Combines MEMORY.md flat-file recall, multi-topic memory directory, Knowledge Graph (KG) entity/relationship store, and Open Empire Nexus for cross-session intelligence.
model_policy: Zero-cost: file-based recall first; KG REST for structured queries; LLM only for synthesis
startup: kg-api always-on; nexus services continuous; memory files always accessible
validation: PASS: kg-api online, 58 KG entities, 81 workspace MD files, memory dir populated
approval_gates: No approval needed for read; Nathan approval for bulk memory purge
rollback: Restore KG from latest clawdb SQL backup; restore MEMORY.md from git/backup
kpi: Memory recall accuracy / KG entity growth rate / zero-token recall rate
